title: ME60106: Manufacture Of Plastic Products
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction: polymeric materials, Engineering plastics, Polymer alloys,
Selection of plastics, Mechanical properties, Degradation, Wear resistance,
Frictional properties, Special properties, Structural features, Expanded
plastics, Plastics as packaging material. Theoretical aspects; Visco-elastic
behaviour, Mathematical models for visco-elastic behaviour, Deformation
behaviour of plastics, Reinforced plastics. Analysis of polymer melt flow;
Newtonian and non Newtonian fluid flow, Flow in circular section, Flow in
rectangular section etc. Overview and analysis of various plastics forming
operations; Extrusion, Injection moulding, Thermo-forming, Calendaring,
Compression moulding, Blow moulding, Transfer moulding, Processing of
reinforced plastics, Die design for simple components.
